subject: PolarisEdge onboarding — temporary invoice-only onboarding request and evidence
messages:
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@polarisedge.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PolarisEdge onboarding — request for invoice-only path while vendor setup completes

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get PolarisEdge live on Redwood for our internal search assistant pilot. We have a short procurement constraint: our legal team requires we use our corporate SOW process but our ERP integration will take 3–4 weeks. Is there a way to get started with an invoice-only billing path (net 30) for the first two months while vendor setup (PO + vendor code) completes? We expect initial spend to be small (~$2–3k first month).

Attached: PolarisEdge_W9.pdf, PolarisEdge_ProofOfInsurance.pdf.

If you need any additional tax or legal documents, point me to the checklist and I’ll get them over. Also looping finance: finance@polarisedge.com.

Best,
Evan
Head of Ops, PolarisEdge

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@polarisedge.com>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PolarisEdge onboarding — request for invoice-only path while vendor setup completes

Hi Evan — thanks for the quick follow-up and for sending the W-9 and insurance. We can usually accommodate a short invoice-only path for pilots, provided Procurement + Finance sign off on a temporary allowance and we capture a few controls (spend cap, evidence, payment terms).

Next steps from our side:
- Priya (Procurement) — can you confirm required evidence and whether a 60-day temporary invoice allowance is feasible?
- Kimberly (Finance) — quick read on risk and whether we can route invoices to Accounts Payable on net 30 while vendor record is being created.

Evan — could you also send a sample invoice (PDF) and the remit-to details so Finance has them on hand?

I’ll add this to the onboarding tracker and share the mutual action plan link.

Jordan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, Evan Liu <evan.liu@polarisedge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PolarisEdge onboarding — request for invoice-only path while vendor setup completes

Thanks Jordan. Evan — appreciate the docs. Procurement is comfortable evaluating a limited temporary invoice-only allowance under the following conditions: 

1) Limit the allowance to $7,500 total (covering pilot + buffer).
2) Temporary period: 60 calendar days from first invoice receipt.
3) PolarisEdge must provide tax ID, remit-to, and a sample PDF invoice (request existing or mock).
4) We require an emailed acceptance of standard Redwood T&Cs (link below) or a signed SOW confirming scope and estimated spend.
5) Evidence to be stored in the vendor intake folder and procurement will open a provisional vendor record pending formal PO creation.

If all items are provided, Procurement will mark the account as "Temporary Invoice Allowlist" and Finance will be asked to route incoming invoices to AP for payment under the allowance. After 60 days or when cumulative invoices exceed $7,500, a PO and vendor code must be in place.

Please attach the sample invoice and remit details. If PolarisEdge needs a faster vendor code, we can escalate but it typically takes 7–14 business days.

Link to T&Cs and intake checklist: https://docs.company/procurement/vendor-intake-checklist

- Priya
Senior Procurement Manager

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, Evan Liu <evan.liu@polarisedge.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PolarisEdge onboarding — request for invoice-only path while vendor setup completes

Quick update / approval: Finance reviewed the provided W-9 and insurance; tax ID verified. We will approve a provisional invoice-only payment path under Priya's conditions. Action items and timeline: 

- Evan: please send the sample invoice (PDF) to finance@redwood.ai with remit-to and a PO line description (product: 'Redwood API usage - pilot').
- Procurement: Priya to create a provisional vendor entry tagged TEMP-INVOICE-4821 and upload evidence to shared drive.
- Finance: AP to process incoming invoices net 30, annotate payments with "TEMP-INVOICE-4821" reference.

Note: This is an exception and will be closed automatically after 60 days or upon PO creation. If PolarisEdge expects charges > $7,500 before PO is created, do not invoice until the vendor code is active.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: sample_invoice.pdf
